officialLinks.label: Grade values; undergraduate GPA; P/NP; I; planning calculator

helpIntro: Clemson uses a 4.0 undergraduate scale. Enter Clemson credit hours and grades to estimate current, projected, or target GPA.
helpNote: For undergraduate Clemson GPA only. Transfer grades and P/NP do not count. An I is treated as an F until resolved. Academic Forgiveness is request-based, so exclude a D/F only after Clemson approves it. Graduate grading uses a different scale.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12 quality points and a 4-credit B earns 12; 24 ÷ 7 = 3.429.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1 quality point per credit hour; eligible D grades may be removed only through approved Academic Forgiveness.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0 quality points; the course still affects GPA unless officially forgiven.
gradeExplanations.I: I is temporary and is calculated as an F until replaced by a final grade.
gradeExplanations.P: P does not affect Clemson GPA.
gradeExplanations.NP: NP does not affect Clemson GPA.
gradeExplanations.W: W does not affect Clemson GPA.

specialTypes.name: Clemson course, undergraduate grading
specialTypes.note: Use A/B/C/D/F/I or excluded P/NP/W as recorded.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Transfer credit may apply to the degree, but transfer grades do not enter Clemson GPA.

specialTypes.name: Officially forgiven Clemson D/F course
specialTypes.note: Select only after Clemson has approved Academic Forgiveness for that course; this calculator does not decide eligibility.

specialTypes.name: Graduate-level / graduate record course
specialTypes.note: Graduate grading uses a different scale; calculate the graduate record separately.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter repeated attempts as separate Clemson courses unless an attempt has officially been removed from GPA through Academic Forgiveness.
